title: 100,000 Statues or 51,000: Longmen or Yungang? | China Travel Expert
description:
Yungang's 51,000 carvings, or Longmen's 100,000 - which cliff wins?

Yungang, in the hills west of Datong, holds 252 caves and more than 51,000 statues, carved in about 60 years from 460 AD. Longmen, on the Yi River at Luoyang, has 2,345 niches and well over 100,000 statues, cut across four centuries. They are two of China's greatest cliff-carving sites, and both are UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

🧭 Expert Tip: Match it to your route - Yungang pairs with Datong (and the Hanging Temple), Longmen with Luoyang and its peonies. If you only have time for one, pick the city you're already visiting.
